methodology: DB::getQueryLog() and microtime() on seeded PostgreSQL database with 500 students, 1000 guardians, 10 classes

queries_sample_25.sql: select * from "semester" where "sekolah_id" = ? and "semester"."sekolah_id" = ? order by "tanggal_mulai" desc

select "roles".*, "model_has_roles"."model_id" as "pivot_model_id", "model_has_roles"."role_id" as "pivot_role_id", "model_has_roles"."model_type" as "pivot_model_type", "model_has_roles"."sekolah_id" as "pivot_sekolah_id" from "roles" inner join "model_has_roles" on "roles"."id" = "model_has_roles"."role_id" where "model_has_roles"."sekolah_id" = ? and ("roles"."sekolah_id" is null or "roles"."sekolah_id" = ?) and "model_has_roles"."model_id" in (515) and "model_has_roles"."model_type" = ?

select "permissions".*, "model_has_permissions"."model_id" as "pivot_model_id", "model_has_permissions"."permission_id" as "pivot_permission_id", "model_has_permissions"."model_type" as "pivot_model_type", "model_has_permissions"."sekolah_id" as "pivot_sekolah_id" from "permissions" inner join "model_has_permissions" on "permissions"."id" = "model_has_permissions"."permission_id" where "model_has_permissions"."model_id" = ? and "model_has_permissions"."model_type" = ? and "model_has_permissions"."sekolah_id" = ?

select "permissions".*, "role_has_permissions"."role_id" as "pivot_role_id", "role_has_permissions"."permission_id" as "pivot_permission_id" from "permissions" inner join "role_has_permissions" on "permissions"."id" = "role_has_permissions"."permission_id" where "role_has_permissions"."role_id" in (1710)

select "roles".*, "role_has_permissions"."permission_id" as "pivot_permission_id", "role_has_permissions"."role_id" as "pivot_role_id" from "roles" inner join "role_has_permissions" on "roles"."id" = "role_has_permissions"."role_id" where "role_has_permissions"."permission_id" in (5125, 5126, 5127, 5128, 5129, 5130, 5131, 5132, 5133, 5134, 5135, 5136, 5137, 5138, 5139, 5140, 5141, 5142, 5143, 5144, 5145)
select count(*) as "aggregate" from "siswa" where "siswa"."sekolah_id" = ? and "siswa"."deleted_at" is null
select * from "siswa" where "siswa"."sekolah_id" = ? and "siswa"."deleted_at" is null order by "nama" asc limit 25 offset 0

select * from "anggota_rombel" where exists (select * from "semester" where "anggota_rombel"."semester_id" = "semester"."id" and "is_aktif" = ? and "semester"."sekolah_id" = ?) and "anggota_rombel"."siswa_id" in (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) and "anggota_rombel"."sekolah_id" = ?

select "rombel".*, (select count(*) from "anggota_rombel" where "rombel"."id" = "anggota_rombel"."rombel_id" and exists (select * from "siswa" where "anggota_rombel"."siswa_id" = "siswa"."id" and "status" = ? and "siswa"."sekolah_id" = ? and "siswa"."deleted_at" is null) and "anggota_rombel"."sekolah_id" = ?) as "jumlah_siswa" from "rombel" where "semester_id" = ? and "rombel"."sekolah_id" = ? order by "tingkat" asc, "nama" asc
